evidence: Changes in global business operations, such as the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence ("AI"), despite human oversight, may also adversely impact our business, financial condition or results of operations.
ai_positioning.summary: Prologis est un EXPLORATEUR de l'opportunité IA via deux axes : (1) conversion de sites logistiques en data centers IA (pipeline >2 GW de power capacity), capitalizing on AI compute demand ; (2) utilisation IA interne pour optimisation portfolio logistique mondial (~1.2 Mds sq ft). La sté annonce ambition data center significative en partenariat avec hyperscalers, transformation business model partielle vers infrastructure IA.

company_description: Prologis, Inc. is a self-administered and self-managed REIT and is the sole general partner of Prologis, L.P. through which it holds substantially all of its assets. We operate Prologis, Inc. and Prologis, L.P. as one enterprise and, therefore, our discussion and analysis refer to Prologis, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, including Prologis, L.P. We invest in real estate through wholly owned subsidiaries and other entities through which we co-invest with partners and investors (co-investment ventures). We have a significant ownership interest in the co-investment ventures, which are either consolidated or unconsolidated based on our level of control of the entity. Prologis, Inc. began operating as a fully integrated real estate company in 1997 and elected to be taxed as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (Internal Revenue Code or IRC). We believe the current organization and method of operation enable Prologis, Inc. to maintain its status as a REIT. Prologis, L.P. was also formed in 1997. We operate, manage and measure the operating performance of our properties on an owned and managed (O&M) basis. Our O&M portfolio includes our consolidated properties as well as properties owned by our unconsolidated co investment ventures, which we manage. We make operating decisions based on our total O&M portfolio as we manage the properties without regard to their ownership. Prologis, Inc. was incorporated in 1983 in Maryland, USA.

risks.title: Sensibilité aux taux d'intérêt et valorisation immobilière
risks.score_rationale: Section Financing haut Item 1A: 'may adversely affect our operating results and financial condition'. Sensibilité taux au cœur d'un REIT logistique, mais langage 'may' pas critique max. Citation: "Changes in interest rates can cause interest expense to fluctuate on our variable rate debt". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Un régime de taux élevés pèse sur les cap rates, réduit les valorisations et augmente le coût de refinancement des 34,5 Mds $ de dette. Le pricing power sur les loyers doit compenser.

risks.title: Demande logistique et cycle e-commerce
risks.score_rationale: Milieu Item 1A: 'could adversely affect our business'. Demande logistique normalisée post-boom, langage conditionnel. Citation: "Our sensitivity analysis estimates the exposure to market risk sensitive instruments assuming a hypothetical 10%". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Après le pic COVID, la demande logistique s'est normalisée. Amazon et les 3PL ajustent leurs prises à bail, ce qui impacte les taux d'occupation et les hausses de loyer.

risks.title: Concentration locataires et risque crédit
risks.score_rationale: Concentration locataires: 'could adversely affect' résultats. Portefeuille très diversifié, pas d'exposition chiffrée alarmante. Citation: "At December 31, 2025, the weighted average effective interest rate on our variable rate debt". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Amazon, DHL, FedEx et quelques 3PL représentent une part significative du loyer. Une défaillance ou renégociation impacterait les revenus.

risks.title: Exposition change et opérations internationales
risks.score_rationale: Section Global Operations: 'may adversely affect our results of operations and financial position'. Change EUR/JPY mais couverture active, langage matériel modéré. Citation: "Foreign currency market risk is the possibility that our results of operations or financial position". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les actifs européens, asiatiques et latino-américains exposent aux fluctuations FX. Les hedges naturels (dette locale) atténuent sans supprimer.

risks.title: Risque développement et sur-construction
risks.score_rationale: Développement: 'could adversely affect' résultats. Sur-construction évoquée sans quantification, langage prudentiel. Citation: "Foreign currency market risk is the possibility that our results of operations or financial position". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Le pipeline de développement (build-to-suit et spéculatif) expose au risque d'occupation et de rendement inférieur si le marché tourne.

risks.title: Risques climatiques physiques et transition
risks.score_rationale: Climat milieu Item 1A: 'may adversely affect' résultats. Régulations reporting mentionnées, langage prudentiel. Citation: "Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Ow ners and Management and Related Stockholder Matters The information". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les hubs logistiques côtiers sont exposés aux ouragans et inondations. La transition (efficacité énergétique, solaire toiture) implique du capex additionnel.

risks.title: Cybersécurité et systèmes bâtiments intelligents
risks.score_rationale: Cyber bas Item 1A: 'could adversely affect our business'. Bloc bref, boilerplate, surface d'attaque bâtiments limitée. Citation: "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data for more information about our foreign operations and derivative financial". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les systèmes IoT bâtiments et plateformes tenant portal exposent à des intrusions. Une brèche affecterait données locataires et opérations.
